mapper.sql: memory_record.id, memory_record.workspace_id, memory_record.memory_type, memory_record.content_json, memory_record.source_type, memory_record.source_id, memory_record.confidence, memory_record.expires_at, memory_record.status, memory_record.version, memory_record.created_at, memory_record.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM memory_record JOIN workspace w ON w.id = memory_record.workspace_id AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE memory_record.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND memory_record.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND (memory_record.expires_at IS NULL OR memory_record.expires_at > #{now}) ORDER BY memory_record.confidence DESC, memory_record.updated_at DESC, memory_record.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
